notes.title: Updated to Version 3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!

We've updated the game to version 3.
The changes are:[/p][olist][*][p]Added COIN ATTACK mode, where score only shows the coins you got that run![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with coins[/p][/*][*][p]Improved physics system to get better performance on real hardware[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the skin change logic[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Updated to Version 2

The changes are:
[olist]
[*]Added fullscreen option to the desktop version
[*]Added EXIT option to the desktop version
[/olist]

This covers the requests so far.

Thank you very much to everyone who tested it so far!!

notes.title: Physical Editions
notes.notes:
Hello!

If like the game, and want to support what we do, we partnered with The Retro Room Games to create the physical edition of this game!

The game for SEGA Genesis/Mega Drive will contain a cartridge, an original box, and an instruction booklet.

You can check it our on The Retro Room Games [url=https://theretroroomgames.com/products/prisonela-md]website[/url].
